source_title: Eerste deel van AHN 5 is beschikbaar!
verified_dutch_excerpts: alleen de daken als gebouw aangemerkt
De rest van het gebouw is aangemerkt als overig
chinese_paraphrase: AHN官方说明：AHN4将整个建筑归为class6；AHN5则仅将屋顶归为该建筑类别，其余建筑部分归为overig（其他）。
class6_implication: For this actual AHN5 delivery, production class6 has explicit roof semantics rather than only generic ASPRS whole-building semantics. Deleting it is a meaningful roof-support domain-risk diagnostic, not independent human-GT error verification.
class1_boundary: Observed class1 is heterogeneous other/unclassified, never tree GT. The cited article places non-roof building parts in overig but does not explicitly state a numeric class code for overig; no stronger numeric taxonomy claim is inferred from this article alone.
